description: Mandatory deterministic fixture (CLAUDE.md, docs/07 §3). Canonical state hashes for the fixed seed + DEFAULT_CONFIG + the fixed command log below (one command of every intervention kind, Milestone 9). Intentional engine behavior changes require an ENGINE_VERSION bump, regenerated hashes (pnpm headless --seed 0xE0A12026 --ticks 10000 --checkpoints 0,1,10,100,1000,10000 --fixture-commands) and a CHANGELOG entry. Engine 0.7.0 regenerated every hash: the canonical stream gained the founder region and the command log, event payloads became signed 32-bit words, the config gained the interventions section, and the fixture now RUNS the command log — the trajectory legitimately diverges from 0.6.0 once the first command applies at tick 50 (by tick 10000: population 4381 vs 4364, 26 drowning deaths from the flooded LOWER_TERRAIN stroke, a meteor crater at the founder centre). Tick 0 and 1 differ from 0.6.0 only through the hash-stream and config changes; the organism trajectory is identical until the first command applies.
